hackathon.english: A 24 to 48-hour team marathon where students build a working prototype software or app from scratch and present it to judges.
hackathon.tanglish: Hackathon-na bayapadatheenga! Adhu oru coding festival maadhiri. Oru 24-48 hours-la chinna team-ah serndhu oru useful prototype app pannanum. First-time participate pandradhe periya learning experience!
hackathon.tip: You don't need to be an expert to enter. In fact, most hackathons have special beginner categories and provide free mentors!

github.english: A cloud platform where programmers store, share, and collaborate on code files using the Git version tracking system.
github.tanglish: Namma Google Drive maadhiri, aana programmers code save panna use panra cloud locker. Yaar eppo enna change pannanga-nu line-by-line track pannum. Recruiter unga profile-ah paarthu nambuvaanga.
github.tip: Having even 2 simple repositories with clean README files beats 10 certificates on your resume.

open source.english: Software whose original source code is made freely available to the public and may be redistributed and modified by anyone.
open source.tanglish: Yaru venaalum code-ah eduthu paarkalaam, use pannalaam, improve pannalaam. World-la irukra big tech companies (Google, Meta) kooda open-source projects-ah rely panranga. Neenga chinna typo fix panna kooda contribute pannalaam!
open source.tip: Start with 'good first issue' labels to fix documentation or small bugs.

api.english: A messenger mechanism that allows two different computer software systems to communicate and exchange data securely.
api.tanglish: Restaurant-la Waiter maadhiri! Neenga (App) menu paathu food order panna, waiter (API) kitchen-ku (Server/Database) poi food eduthu varuvaaru. Two apps pesikka use aagum.
api.tip: When you check live cricket scores or weather on your phone, an API brings that data.

repository.english: A dedicated digital folder or storage space on Git/GitHub that holds all project files, history, and documentation.
repository.tanglish: Oru project-oda official file folder. Idhula unga code, images, explanation documents (README) ellam irukkum.
repository.tip: Always include a README.md file in every repository explaining what the project does.

internship.english: A temporary professional work experience (usually 2 to 6 months) offered by companies to students to gain real-world practical skills.
internship.tanglish: College padikkum pothe oru company-la trainee-ah vela paathu real-world project epdi run aagudhu-nu kathukra chance. Neraya internships stipend (salary) tharuvanga.
internship.tip: Prioritize internships where you get code reviews over those where you only watch slides.

ats.english: Automated software used by recruiters to scan, filter, and score resumes against job description keywords before a human reads them.
ats.tanglish: Companies unga resume-ah aal vechu padikrathukku munnadi, oru computer software scan pannum. Keyword match irundha dhaan interview call varum. Cluttered graphic templates avoid pannanum.
ats.tip: Use clean single-column plain text and list specific verified technologies (React, SQL, Python).

portfolio.english: A curated collection of your best live projects, code repositories, and evidence demonstrating what you can actually build.
portfolio.tanglish: Certificates mattum kaataama, 'Idho naane build panna 3 projects, live link idho, code idho'-nu unga thiramaya prove panra showcase.
portfolio.tip: Three solid working projects with demo links are 10x more persuasive than 20 course completion badges.

ci/cd.english: Automated pipeline that tests your code whenever you make changes and automatically deploys healthy code to users.
ci/cd.tanglish: Neenga GitHub-la code upload pannavudane, automatic-ah tests run aagi, ella mistakes-um check pannittu, website-la deploy aagura smart pipeline.
ci/cd.tip: GitHub Actions is a free and popular way to practice simple CI/CD.

framework.english: A pre-built structure and library of reusable code tools that speeds up building applications without reinventing the wheel.
framework.tanglish: Veedu kattum podhu readymade scaffolding maadhiri! Scratch-la irundhu basic things panna theva illa; standard rules & helpers irukkum, adha vechu fast-ah app build pannalaam.
framework.tip: Master the core language (JavaScript or Python) first before jumping straight into a framework.

pull request.english: A request made to project maintainers asking them to review and merge your proposed code changes into the main codebase.
pull request.tanglish: 'Naan indha issue-ku solution ezhudhirukken, check pannittu unga main project-oda sethukonga' nu maintainer-kita kekkum polite request.
pull request.tip: Keep your pull requests small and write a friendly 2-sentence description of what you changed.

full stack.english: Proficiency in both the user-facing visual frontend and the server-database backend of an application.
full stack.tanglish: Front-end (kannula theriyura screen) and Back-end (pinnaadi odura server, database) rendu side-layum work panna therinja all-rounder.
full stack.tip: You don't need to know everything at day 1. Start with frontend and slowly connect a simple database.
